title: Choose CivicFix's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Painted Notice Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Painted Notice Board
options.lineage: Delhi sign-painters' enamel boards: the painted RWA "Notice Board", shop boards, auto lettering
options.thesis: CivicFix as the block's hand-painted notice board: every issue a painted notice, every vote a number the whole street can read.
options.viewport: Painted masthead board with the three status tallies, painted category tabs, then notices as square tin plates led by a big hand-set upvote numeral; yellow painted Report plate in the bottom plank.
options.risk: Drop-shaded lettering tips into truck-art costume if it leaves the masthead and numerals.

raised.raise: No radius anywhere; states are painted marks: outlined at rest, filled when chosen, struck through when resolved.
Map pins and heat scale on a fixed upvote ramp, so community weight reads before any label.
Every count is set in fixed-width figures so tallies never jitter as they change.
A notice's location line jumps straight to its own pin on the map: feed and map are one space.
One 1px line weight and one inset pinstripe carry every division; nothing else draws a box.

options.label: Mohalla Chalkboard
options.lineage: chai-stall and dhaba chalkboards, the society gate's slate
options.thesis: The neighbourhood chalks up what's broken and tallies who agrees.
options.viewport: Slate ground, chalked masthead, notices separated by chalk rules with five-bar tally marks for upvotes.
options.risk: The most familiar 'community' trope here, and chalk texture slides into skeuomorphism; green-black reads cooler than asked.

options.label: Ticket & Gate Board
options.lineage: boarding pass segments and a live departures board
options.thesis: Each issue is a stubbed ticket; the feed is a board that re-ranks and holds a changed status lit until you've seen it.
options.viewport: A ranked board of issue rows with segmented columns (category, place, age, votes); the top row expanded as a ticket.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and wins on status clarity, but loses audience identification: an airport isn't the neighbourhood.
options.risk: Reads as a travel app wearing civic copy.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Two text columns round a rail of keys, states as printed marks.
options.viewport: Dense twin columns with a keyed centre rail.
options.case: A citizen on a pavement doesn't identify with a scholarly edition; the structure fights a phone feed.
options.kept: States as printed marks and no radius anywhere.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Importance drawn as dot size on a fixed magnitude ramp.
options.viewport: A star chart of Delhi's issues.
options.case: Cold and nocturnal; poetic but not the neighbourhood.
options.kept: Pin and heat weight on a fixed upvote ramp.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Rows as live entities, characters in fixed cells.
options.case: Matte black is exactly the look being replaced.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.thesis: A packed coded grid that is the same space as the hall map.
options.case: Too dense for a street report; no civic identification.
options.kept: Feed and map as one space: a notice jumps to its pin.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Registration furniture and one grotesque on near-white stock.
options.case: Gallery-cool and near-white; contradicts warm and dark.
options.kept: One line weight carries every division.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark civic-reporting app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: App bar, stat cards, chip filters, image-left issue cards, floating report button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other reporting app by design.
